Package hadur2.core.gun

Class AntiSurferGun

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.gun.AntiSurferGun
public class AntiSurferGun extends Object
The anti-surfer gun: four small, fast-forgetting KNN views whose neighbours are pooled and scored on a fixed grid of firing angles.

A wave surfer learns where our bullets go and moves away from them, so old data about it goes stale. The four views keep only the latest 125, 400, 1,500 and 4,000 waves (the FIFO caps also bound them, RES-2) and return at most three neighbours each, so the aim leans on what the target did recently. In a duel each neighbour gives a guess factor, scaled by the precise escape angle on its side; with several opponents it would give a displacement vector, projected as the main gun does. The chosen angle is the one of 59 evenly spaced offsets across the maximum escape angle where the pooled neighbours are densest.

GunController uses it in duels only: when the virtual guns rate it above the main gun, or from the first wave when the opening book picks it (ADAPT-1). Angles are Robocode bearings in radians, 0 north and clockwise; a guess factor is in [-1, 1], positive in the target's orbit direction.

    • aim

      public double aim(Wave w, Map<String,KnnView<TimestampedFiringAngle>> views, Point2D.Double myNextLocation, long currentTime)
      The absolute bearing to fire along, in radians.
      Parameters:
      w - the gun wave for the shot
      views - the target's gun views; the anti-surfer ones are read by name
      myNextLocation - where we will be when the bullet leaves, the next tick
      currentTime - the present tick
      Returns:
      the densest bearing in [0, 2pi), or w.absBearing (head-on from the wave's source) while no view holds at least its kDivisor (10) points that still count
